epics.title: Epic: M0 - Environment & decisions
epics.body:
Everyone can build and install a sample in a test VM, and the core design decisions are made.

Exit criteria: every member has completed docs/setup.md sections 1-5, and ADR-0001, 0002 and 0005 are Accepted.

epics.title: Epic: M1 - Minimal microphone
epics.body:
A capture-only Virtual Tone Microphone that produces a 440 Hz sine at 50% in PCM 16-bit stereo 48 kHz, right after boot, verified by recording.

Exit criteria: M1 section of docs/testing.md passes on Windows 11.

epics.title: Epic: M2 - Control path
epics.body:
Shared interface agreed, communication library and GUI working, parameters changed live without restarting the stream.

Exit criteria: M2 section of docs/testing.md passes.

epics.title: Epic: M3 - Hardening
epics.body:
Install/uninstall without reboot, Driver Verifier clean, tested on Windows 10 and 11.

Exit criteria: all R requirements in docs/requirements.md marked Verified.

epics.title: Epic: M4 - Additional features
epics.body: Additional features from the spec, in its order: tests, extra options, presets, monitoring, real-mic mixing.
